about_the_game:
A fusion of fast-paced movement and first person shooting. This is SLIDEFORCE, where sliding is the key to success. Shoot down the enemies on the way, while also keeping your momentum and get the fastest time you can in a cyberpunk setting.

FAST-PACED

The movement you've been looking for this entire time. This is that game. Manoeuvre on 10+ levels and get the fastest time you can.

EPIC GUN FIGHTS

Who doesn't love guns? Especially when it's combined with sick explosions, and realistic screen shake? I gotcha.

LEVEL EDITOR

Got an idea for a level and would like to test it out? You can use it to create levels using a built-in map editor with a simple interface.

Available 2025 for free on Steam.
